Figure 2: Visual saturation in MLLMs. (a) Adjacent-layer cosine similarity cos(ℎ𝓁 , ℎ𝓁+1): vision tokens saturate ≥ 0.92 from 𝐿0 onwards, while text tokens climb in deep layers. (b) Text-to-image attention mass: drops 10× in the first four layers and asymptotes to 0.04 after 𝐿18. (c) Logit-lens KL divergence to the final-layer distribution: the vision 50%-transition occurs at 𝐿22, the text transition at 𝐿23 (LLM-only baseline). All curves: 500 LLaVA-665k samples, per-sample median with IQR band. The vertical dashed line at 𝓁 = 18 marks the split layer used by DPVR-LF.
